title: TOOLS-005: Metadata extractor passes paths through a shell and trusts a failed pipe
description:
Current reconciliation: indigo_driver_metadata.c now uses PATH_MAX and checked snprintf; its old fixed128/strcpy subclaim is obsolete. indigo_metadata_extractor still interpolates a path into a shell command and does not check popen failure before use. Next: avoid shell interpretation and handle process/pipe failure; preserve bounded metadata path handling. No repair, closure or risk acceptance is claimed.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000040.json (category: security, blocking: no).
